tokens.v: Drop it into the fold and shoot the settle: the last coil of chain still whipping, blurred, while the pearl and the length already at rest lock sharp across the halved artichoke's cut face, nacre against wet fibrous flesh. 90mm at f/2.8, camera high and looking steeply down into the valley of the fold. A thistle head crosses the top-left corner out of focus, cut by the top and left edges. The chain runs on under the linen where it meets the bottom edge.
